name: DAAD International Programmes in Germany

extractionHints.detail: Programme detail pages carry degree type, teaching language, programme duration, beginning/intake, application deadline, tuition fees and the host university name. The university name is the join key to the University table.

notes: Programme-level catalogue for Germany — 3,666 English detail pages enumerated from www2.daad.de/sitemap.xml (verified 2026-09-05; these are in <loc> directly, unlike the scholarship database whose English URLs live in hreflang alternates). This is the source that makes scholarship→programme linking meaningful: DAAD scholarships state applicability rules rather than naming institutions, so they need a real German programme catalogue to expand those rules against. Shares the DAAD sitemap and Crawl-delay: 2 with src-daad. Full crawl is ~2 hours at 2s/page.
